# Lodge

> A private server/service console. hub + agent architecture, a single static Go binary.

## About

Lodge discovers what services run on each of your machines and what they're exposed to (local / tailnet / public). An agent runs on each managed machine under a non-root account with a sudoers allowlist for the few privileged actions it needs; a central hub polls the agents and serves a password-protected web UI. An end-to-end encrypted vault remains on the roadmap and is not a current security promise.

## Repository

https://github.com/toolazytoname/lodge
